request: Collect existing naturally occurring Core real-task performance aggregates and host resource state from live authenticated metrics; no new inference or any product/source mutation. Post concise nonsecret fact once to Core Current.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
report=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c '
import os,json,urllib.request
h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]}
def get(path):
 q=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184"+path,headers=h)
 return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(q,timeout=8))
m=get("/internal/metrics/status")
r=get("/internal/resources/status")
models={n:{"count":v["completed"],"ok":v["success"],"p50":v["latency_ms_p50"],"p95":v["latency_ms_p95"],"ttft":v["stream_first_token_ms_p50"],"tps":v["effective_output_tps_p50"]} for n,v in m["model_metrics"].items()}
print(json.dumps({"persistence":m["persistence"],"window":m["window_completed"],"models":models,"active":sum(r["active"].values()),"queue":r["queued"],"resident":r.get("resident"),"mem":r["memory"].get("memory.current"),"psi":r.get("pressure")},separators=(",",":")))
')
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="AI_CORE_NATURAL_WORKLOAD_METRICS SOURCE=81d75017d0fd0ddc631e0c6de862c1cc0d4d662d $report" --jq .html_url >/dev/null
echo AI_CORE_NATURAL_WORKLOAD_METRICS_RECORDED=YES
